title: Coefficient of $T^m$ in a polynomial
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $T$ an indeterminate. A polynomial
$P(T)\in R[T]$ is a finite sum $P(T)=\sum_{r\geq0}c_rT^r$ with
coefficients $c_r\in R$ indexed by integers $r\geq0$, all but finitely
many zero. For an integer $m\geq0$, the coefficient of $T^m$ in $P$ is

$$
[T^m]P(T)=c_m\in R.
$$

For $P\neq0$, the degree $\deg P$ is the largest $m$ with
$[T^m]P(T)\neq0$, and the leading coefficient of $P$ is
$[T^{\deg P}]P(T)$.
